name: Makita Corporation
summary: Makita Corporation engages in the production and sales of electric power tools, pneumatic tools, and gardening and household equipment in Japan, Europe, North America, Asia, Central and South America, Oceania, The Middle East, and Africa. The company offers construction and building tools, such as cordless impact driver, cordless circular saw, cordless belt sander, cordless multi tool, cordless impact wrench, and cordless framing nailer. It also provides gardening tools, including cordless pruning saw, cordless pole hedge trimmer, cordless edger, cordless blower, cordless scarifier, and cordless pole saw.
